event_name: NHRA New England Nationals presented by bproauto

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 76 degrees, relative humidity 61 percent, barometer 29.69 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,069 feet, track temperature 109 degrees.

Todd is 13 - 2 against Alexander in prior events. 

Alexander with the starting line advantage, but the car starts drifting out of the groove toward the wall
before he lifts.

Todd kept it hooked up and hitting on all eight for the win.

Hagan is 34 - 26 against Beckman in prior events. 

Hagan with the starting line advantage, but Beckman has the difference made up b 330 feet and takes the win.

Green and Vandergriff have each won 2 times against the other in prior events. 

They have identical reaction times, but Vandergriff has the lead from there on for the win.  Jordan
Vandergriff's MOV: 0.0331 seconds (approximately 16 feet).  He makes the quickest pass of the round for the
win and lane choice over Todd in the semifinal.

Capps is 31 - 6 against DeJoria in prior events. 

DeJoria with the starting line advantage and the lead until right in the lights when Capps drove around her
for the win in a close one.  Ron Capps' MOV: 0.0018 seconds (approximately 10 inches).  Capps with the
quickest pass of the round and will have lane choice over Beckman in the semifinal.
